purpose: Source-level ownership map for overlapping trading-system modules. Owners are authoritative only for the scoped contract stated here; this is not a claim of end-to-end integration, production readiness, or profitable performance.

contracts.scope: Operator-facing forward-edge preflight, historical replay, and archived-data paper commands.
contracts.boundary: Does not start the prospective ForwardSessionRunner from live Kite observations; replay and archived-data paper modes are not prospective evidence.

contracts.scope: Normalized market-event ingestion, decision/risk evidence, simulated fills, and durable session lifecycle.
contracts.boundary: The runner accepts normalized events and has no physical-order method; a live Kite quote-to-runner session command remains absent. The legacy paper live loop is a separate trading-day engine and not a substitute for this evidence lifecycle.

contracts.scope: Existing intraday strategy engine, Kite quote polling, replay, and legacy paper ledger.
contracts.boundary: Provides a read-only Kite quote path and its own paper persistence; not an adapter into ForwardSessionRunner and not independently timestamp-attested.

contracts.scope: Broker order submission, broker acknowledgements, status and reconciliation.
contracts.boundary: Broker OMS is distinct from simulated paper execution; physical-order policy and enabled broker pathways must remain separately gated.

contracts.scope: Quote eligibility, execution scenario evaluation, and simulated receipt persistence for prospective sessions.
contracts.boundary: Options intent simulation is a separate scoped contract; this owner does not establish complete option lifecycle or live execution.

contracts.scope: Research sleeve allocation based on estimated mean, uncertainty, drift state and money gate.
contracts.boundary: The forward-edge allocator enforces candidate-level portfolio controls; it is a separate order-intent risk gate, not a replacement for research sleeve sizing. End-to-end capital allocation across books is not established by either owner alone.

contracts.scope: Frozen paper eligibility, status transitions, benchmark linkage, and strategy-version history.
contracts.boundary: AlgorithmSpec captures algorithm clocks, costs and deterministic behavior constraints; it is not the promotion registry. Cross-registry identity/version synchronization remains unresolved.

contracts.scope: Forward-only champion-pick attestation and immutable pick manifests.
contracts.boundary: Prospective attestation records decisions; evidence_stats and governance evaluate evidence/promotion gates. No single module owns all evaluation, and specialized evaluation modules remain separate by metric or study.

contracts.scope: Validated sampled price paths, path-dependent risk/target questions, and empirical quantiles.
contracts.boundary: Distribution is the forecast-output contract; model generation, calibration, and validation remain separate components and are not interchangeable owners.

contracts.scope: Append-only canonical multi-asset portfolio events, as-of projections, and P&L promotion gate.
contracts.boundary: Legacy paper ledgers remain source books and migration inputs; unsupported asset lifecycle facts and unresolved source rows continue to block complete consolidated accounting.

unresolved: No single package registry synchronizes AlgorithmSpec and StrategySpec identities, hashes, clocks, cost versions, and promotion status.
No live observed Kite quote adapter starts and feeds ForwardSessionRunner from the operator CLI.
Legacy intraday paper and prospective ForwardSessionRunner maintain distinct persistence/evidence paths; the migration/ownership boundary is documented but not unified.
Research allocation, forward risk controls, and portfolio book-level capital allocation do not yet have one end-to-end risk budget contract.
Specialist evaluation and forecasting modules are intentionally plural; only output/promotion interfaces are scoped here, not a common typed protocol across all models and studies.
